remarks: Live where the city moves in this updated 2 bedroom, 1.5 bath townhouse with attached one car garage, perfectly set in the heart of Downtown Stamford and designed for an active, modern lifestyle. Inside, you'll find a bright, open layout with laminate flooring and an easy flow that works just as well for hosting friends as it does for everyday living. Step out onto your private balcony and enjoy city views that bring energy and atmosphere to your mornings and evenings. This home delivers the features that make city life effortless, including in-unit laundry, a built-in EV charger, and a private attached garage for added convenience. Fully renovated from top to bottom, it offers a move-in-ready experience with a clean, modern feel throughout. Outside your door, you are within walking distance to everything Downtown Stamford has to offer, including restaurants, nightlife, shopping at the mall, and the train station, making it easy to stay connected, spontaneous, and on the go. Whether you're grabbing coffee before work, meeting friends for dinner, or grabbing and express train to NYC, this location supports a dynamic lifestyle without sacrificing comfort at home. If you're looking for a low-maintenance, modern townhouse with a vibrant atmosphere, city views, and unbeatable walkability, this home puts you right in the center of it all.
